mapper.select: SELECT goal_delinquency_state_id, goal_id, behind_since, short_term_fired, long_term_fired, on_track_since, consecutive_fired FROM goal_delinquency_state WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal_delinquency_state ( goal_id, behind_since, short_term_fired, long_term_fired, on_track_since, consecutive_fired ) VALUES ( #{goalId}, #{behindSince}, #{shortTermFired}, #{longTermFired}, #{onTrackSince}, #{consecutiveFired} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE behind_since = VALUES(behind_since), short_term_fired = VALUES(short_term_fired), long_term_fired = VALUES(long_term_fired), on_track_since = VALUES(on_track_since), consecutive_fired = VALUES(consecutive_fired)
